Stepper

An ol with one hook, data-stepper. The current step is aria-current="step". Steps before it read as completed, steps after it as upcoming. No classes.

Horizontal (default)

Checkout progress, no navigation. Put the status in the label text for screen readers.

  1. 1Cart
  2. 2Shipping
  3. 3Payment
  4. 4Review

Navigable steps

When steps are links, wrap the list in a nav and put aria-current on the link. A step the user cannot reach yet is a link without href or with aria-disabled="true".
